rate_limits: Identity-based per-minute limits (new in 2026): unidentified 10 req/min; compliant User-Agent-only or newer authenticated users 200/min; established authenticated users 2,000/min (caveats apply; bots/WMCS may be exempt). Limit concurrent requests to ≤3. Prefer dumps/SPARQL for heavy use.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: auditor correct. Original “not published as fixed quotas” is outdated. Official Wikimedia docs (https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Wikimedia_APIs/Rate_limits, crawled 2026-08-08) publish cross-API 2026 limits: unidentified 10/min; browser unauth / User-Agent-only / new authenticated 200/min; established authenticated 2,000/min; best practice ≤3 concurrent requests. Also linked from API:Etiquette.
